caseName: Dahlstrom Metallic Door Co. v. Industrial Board
caseNameFull: Dahlstrom Metallic Door Co. v. Industrial Board of New York
attorneys: Mr. Robert H. Jackson for appellants. Messrs. John J. Bennett, Jr., Attorney General of New York, and Joseph A. McLaughlin, Assistant Attorney General, were on the brief for appellee., Messrs. John W. Reynolds, Attorney General of Wisconsin, Mortimer Levitan, Assistant Attorney General, and Walter F. Dodd, by leave of Court, filed a brief on behalf of the State of Wisconsin as amicus curiae.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

As this case is governed by principles set forth in New York Central R. Co. v. White, 243 U. S. 188, and Mountain Timber Co. v. Washington, 243 U. S. 219, the judgment is affirmed.
